rdfs:label: mediator
rdfs:comment: A class of agents that mediates access to the resource on behalf of its intended audience — e.g. teachers, parents, librarians, care-givers.
notes: From the educational-resources tradition: the value is a class of agents (e.g. teachers), not an individual person. Used to express that the resource reaches its intended audience (`dcterms:audience` — not `urn:solid:audience`, which is the ActivityStreams addressing property) via that class of intermediaries. Niche outside library/edu contexts.

history.note: Range now dcterms:AgentClass (a class of agents, not an individual); comment/example updated; seeAlso dcterms:audience instead of urn:solid:audience.
